tests.name: Random small
tests.data:
import random
random.seed(7430)
cases = []
for _ in range(40):
    n = random.randint(1, 7)
    pairs = sorted({(random.randint(1, n), random.randint(1, n)) for _ in range(random.randint(0, 14))})
    t = [[u, v, random.randint(0, 20)] for u, v in pairs if u != v]
    cases.append((t, n, random.randint(1, n)))
tests.expr: [network_delay_time(t, n, k) for t, n, k in cases]

tests.hint: Use a heap to pick the next closest node. Scanning every node each time is O(n^2).
